originalCfg: GameData/EffectPrototypes.cfg radiation stages; 11 source prototypes × ValueMin/ValueMax, unchanged thresholds
scope: Author role-specific HP damage multiplier only; preserve radiation accumulation, passive decay, cures, difficulty, and 452 source settings.
notice: The fixed-RAD death time is a hypothetical one-charge-per-second estimate; true runtime cadence, mitigation and stage overlap require gameplay verification.

Anomaly Runner.intent: Artifact runs are high-radiation gambles; extraction and anti-rad planning matter.

Field Medic.intent: Medical expertise and stronger radiation treatment make damage less punishing, never safe.

Hardcore+.intent: Full-scale fatal exposure: the 25x upper cap is deliberate total hardcore.

Hardcore.intent: Near-lethal radiation, with a small survivability margin below Hardcore+.

Immersive.intent: Serious chronic contamination without the instant-death ceiling.

Mercenary.intent: Expensive professional exposure; funded medical supplies offset risk, not damage.

Mutant Hunter.intent: Hazardous mutant hunting in contaminated territory; treatment remains scarce.

Outcast.intent: Brutal exposure with poor treatment access; almost as merciless as Hardcore+.

Scavenger.intent: Looting contaminated wrecks has meaningful HP cost, with some salvager survival margin.

Smuggler.intent: Dangerous illicit routes with some mobility and antirad access.

Tactical.intent: High radiation combat pressure forces disciplined extraction instead of healing through damage.

Wanderer.intent: Least lethal for a long-distance explorer, but still well above vanilla while accumulation remains elevated.
